hi there !
just a little question about a special prevention card :
Skin of night
it allows you to treat aggravated damage like normal damage for the current
round of combat. Superior version says "as above and prevent one damage".
Can the prevention occur later this round, like in "unflintching persistence
"?
so what happens when you play it before range is chosen to counter a "dawn
op + weather control" combo ? is the prevention lost when we go to maneuver
step ?

reyda

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
In article <93ple4$12ps$1...@news4.isdnet.net>,
"Reyda" <re...@noos.fr> wrote:
> Skin of night allows you to treat aggravated damage like normal

> damage for the current round of combat. Superior version says
> "as above and prevent one damage". Can the prevention occur later
> this round, like in "unflintching persistence"?

No.
Without specific card text allowing the delay, you cannot "carry over"
damage prevention to another phase.

> so what happens when you play it before range is chosen to counter
> a "dawn op + weather control" combo ?

The card lets you treat the damage as normal, but it does not prevent
the damage, and its ability to prevent a damage for you is lost.

> is the prevention lost when we go to maneuver step ?

No, it is lost when it is played. If you don't have damage
to prevent, playing it as superior is not of any value to you,
as the card doesn't have text letting you save the prevention
for later.

Carpe Noctem.

Messages.Body:
Skin of night vs Rötsherek

Does Rötsherek work against a vampire who plays Skin of Night?



Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
In article <93q0ks$mng$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

hen...@my-deja.com wrote:
> Skin of night vs Rötsherek
>
> Does Rötsherek work against a vampire who plays Skin of Night?

Yes.
Rotschreck only cares that the attempt to use aggravated damage
is made, not whether or not the vampire will receive the damage.

See the online card text for clarification:

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/Cardlist_R.html#Rotschreck

Rotschreck [Jyhad]
Cardtype: Master
Master: out-of-turn. Play when a minion attempts to use aggravated
damaged against a vampire, whether successfully or not. Combat ends
before damage is resolved. That vampire is put in torpor, tapped, with
this card on it. During the vampire's next untap phase, burn this card
instead of untapping the vampire.

Carpe Noctem.
